verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents a broad programmatic surface. It has a REST API with a live OpenAPI 3.1 document and per-endpoint reference covering agents, runs, browser sessions and credentials, plus Python/TypeScript SDKs and an MCP server exposing 117 tools. That covers the core run-tasks and run-agents functionality the dashboard offers. However, nothing states UI/API parity, and several UI-only features (visual drag-and-drop builder, Copilot agent building, SOP upload, browser recorder, scheduling and template sharing) have no evidenced API equivalents. Missing for 10: an explicit API-parity statement, API coverage of the workflow building/editing, Copilot, SOP upload, recorder, scheduling and sharing features, and hands-on corroboration that API-only use matches the UI.
